SDAS1.label: PA - Request an article through Patient Access

SDAS1.1.label: PA - Request an article through Patient Access
SDAS1.1.description: Definition and required markers: The customer explicitly mentions Patient Access, identifies as a patient or non-professional caregiver, or the agent explicitly confirms that the request is handled through Patient Access. Do not use for healthcare professionals, researchers, pharmacists, or veterinarians unless Patient Access is explicit.

SDAS2.label: INST_INFO - Check whether an institution subscribes to a specific title, year or package

SDAS2.1.label: INST_INFO - Check whether an institution subscribes to a specific title, year or package
SDAS2.1.description: Definition and required markers: A named institution is asking whether it has access to specific content. Markers include: “our institution”, “our library”, subscription, licence, entitlement, holdings, coverage, KBART, title inclusion, package, or coverage years. Use this only where the customer is seeking clarification, rather than reporting a confirmed entitlement failure.

SDAS3.label: INST_ISSUE - Access content that the institution is entitled to, but which is not available to the user

SDAS3.1.label: INST_ISSUE - Access content that the institution is entitled to, but which is not available to the user
SDAS3.1.description: Definition and required markers: A named institution is involved and the ticket shows that access is expected but not delivered. Markers include: “we are subscribed”, “we have paid”, “we should have access”, invoice, agreement, entitlement, ECR, account mapping, institutional token, provisioned title, or agent confirmation of entitlement.

SDAS4.label: PURCHASED - Access an article or subscription purchased directly from ScienceDirect

SDAS4.1.label: PURCHASED - Access an article or subscription purchased directly from ScienceDirect
SDAS4.1.description: Definition and required markers: The customer refers to a personal purchase, order number, receipt, payment, pay-per-view purchase, personal subscription, or order history, and cannot access the purchased content. Do not assume a purchase without an explicit commercial marker.

SDAS5.label: AVAILABILITY - Request a missing article, archive item or supplementary material

SDAS5.1.label: AVAILABILITY - Request a missing article, archive item or supplementary material
SDAS5.1.description: Definition and required markers: The requested content cannot be supplied because it is unavailable, missing, not digitised, or lacks a supplementary/companion file, appendix, dataset, or other supporting material.

SDAS6.1.label: OTHER - Other
SDAS6.1.description: Definition and required markers: When the ticket lacks the required markers for a sub-contact reason, classify it as « other ».
